# Crypto-Cash Back: Getting Started with Crypto Rewards

## Before You Begin
- Confirm that crypto redemptions are available on your account: Yes.
- Note that purchase protection on this card is No.

## How to Start Earning Rewards You Can Redeem in Crypto
1. Make eligible purchases with your card. You earn rewards at 2.0% on those transactions.
2. Track your reward balance in the app. You can prepare for crypto redemption once your balance reaches at least 30 dollars.
3. If you prefer to segregate spending for specific projects or merchants, use virtual cards (when available) to organize and monitor reward accrual. Virtual card management availability: Yes.

## Tips for a Smooth Start
- Set a personal target for your first crypto redemption that meets or exceeds 30.
- Plan larger purchases strategically to accelerate reaching the threshold while staying within your budget.
- Review merchant processing categories in your statements to confirm which transactions earned rewards at the 2.0% rate.

## When You’re Ready to Redeem
- Verify your reward balance has met the 30 requirement.
- Proceed to the crypto redemption flow in the app to choose your cryptocurrency and destination wallet.

## Common Questions at Setup
- How much do I earn per purchase? You earn 2.0%.
- What is the minimum balance to redeem to crypto? 30 dollars.
- Can I organize spending with virtual cards? Yes.# Crypto-Cash Back: How to Redeem Rewards in Your Crypto Wallet

## Prerequisites
- Crypto redemption availability on your account: Yes.
- Minimum reward balance to redeem: 30 dollars.

## Step-by-Step Redemption
1. Open Rewards in your app and choose Redeem to Crypto.
2. Confirm your current reward balance meets the 30 threshold.
3. Select a cryptocurrency from the available list (up to 12 options).
4. Choose your transfer method:
   - If direct wallet integration is available: Yes
   - Otherwise, use manual wallet address entry.
5. Review the estimated conversion. A conversion fee of 1.25% applies to the rewards you convert.
6. Confirm your wallet address and submit the redemption request.

## Timing and Fees
- Conversion fee: 1.25% (applied at the time of conversion).
- The number of available cryptocurrencies can be up to 12.

## Troubleshooting
- Can’t proceed? Ensure your redemption is enabled: Yes.
- Threshold not met? Accumulate more rewards until you reach 30.
- Integration unavailable? If Yes is False, enter your wallet address manually and confirm accuracy before submitting.# Crypto-Cash Back: Supported Cryptocurrencies and Wallets

## Availability Overview
- Crypto redemptions on this program: Yes.
- Number of cryptocurrencies supported for redemption: up to 12.

## Supported Wallet Connections
- Direct wallet integration supported: Yes.
- If direct integration is not supported, you can use manual wallet address entry.

## Selecting a Cryptocurrency
- You can choose from a curated list of up to 12 cryptocurrencies during redemption.
- The list may change over time based on liquidity, security, and network considerations.

## Wallet Compatibility Guidance
- If Yes is True:
  - Link your wallet directly within the app and select it at checkout during redemption.
- If Yes is False:
  - Paste your compatible public wallet address for the selected asset during redemption and verify it carefully.

## Best Practices
- Confirm that your wallet supports the network of the selected cryptocurrency.
- Use a new address only after validating it with a small test transfer in your external wallet, when possible.

# Crypto-Cash Back: Linking Your Crypto Wallet to Your Account

## Determine Your Connection Method
- Direct wallet integration availability: Yes.

## If Direct Integration Is Supported
1. Go to Settings > Crypto Wallets in your app.
2. Choose Add Wallet and select your wallet provider.
3. Authenticate with your wallet provider and approve permissions.
4. Set this wallet as your default destination for crypto redemptions.
5. Complete a verification step if prompted (e.g., signing a message).

## If Direct Integration Is Not Supported
1. Navigate to Rewards > Redeem to Crypto.
2. Select your cryptocurrency and choose Manual Address.
3. Paste your public wallet address and, if applicable, the required memo/tag.
4. Verify the address format and network before saving.
5. Save the address for future redemptions and consider labeling it for clarity.

## Verification Tips
- Always verify the network (e.g., native chain vs. tokenized variants) matches your wallet’s expected format.
- Test with a small redemption after setup to ensure proper delivery before sending larger amounts.# Crypto-Cash Back: Understanding Crypto Reward Conversion Rates

## How Your Rewards Convert
- You earn rewards at 2.0% on eligible purchases.
- When you redeem to crypto, a conversion fee of 1.25% applies to the amount you convert.

## Estimating Your Crypto Payout
- Net rewards converted = Your available rewards × (1 − 1.25%).
- The resulting fiat amount is then exchanged at the real-time market rate into your selected cryptocurrency.

## Practical Planning Tips
- If you anticipate price volatility, consider redeeming in smaller tranches instead of a single large conversion.
- Compare your expected net amount before and after applying the 1.25% to decide when to redeem.
- Remember that rewards accrue at 2.0% regardless of crypto market conditions; only the redemption reflects market pricing.# Crypto-Cash Back: Security and Safety of Crypto Redemptions

## Key Considerations
- Purchase protection on this card is No. Factor this into your decision-making when redeeming and spending.

## Address Verification Best Practices
- Double-check the exact public address and network before confirming a redemption.
- Use saved, verified addresses whenever possible to reduce manual entry errors.
- If your wallet requires a memo/tag, include it accurately; missing or incorrect tags may lead to loss of funds.

## Platform Controls You Can Use
- Enable notifications for redemption confirmations so you can quickly detect any unexpected activity.
- Lock your card or pause redemptions if you suspect unauthorized access until you review activity.

## After You Redeem
- Monitor the transaction status in your wallet and the app for confirmations.
- Keep records of redemption details for reconciliation and potential tax reporting needs.# Crypto-Cash Back: Tax Reporting for Cryptocurrency Rewards

## Document Availability
- Tax reporting documents for crypto redemptions provided: Yes.

## What You Should Do
- Download your annual statements and any provided tax forms related to crypto redemptions.
- Keep detailed records of redemption dates, amounts, and the assets received for your own reporting.

## Timing and Access
- Check the app’s Documents or Tax section after year-end for access to any available forms.
- If additional documentation is required, export your transaction history and provide it to your tax professional.

## Important Notes
- Redemption events may have tax implications depending on your jurisdiction.
- Consult a qualified tax advisor for guidance tailored to your situation.# Crypto-Cash Back: FAQ-2

## Eligibility
- What is the minimum credit score to apply for the card to earn crypto rewards? $660.

## Payments and Fees
- What happens if I pay late? A late payment fee of $32.50 dollars may apply, and late payments can affect your account standing and eligibility to redeem rewards until you are current.

## Tips
- Set up payment reminders to avoid the $32.50 fee and keep your reward redemptions on track.

# Rho-Bank Customer Service Policy

You are a helpful customer service agent for Rho-Bank.
Your goal is to help customers by searching the knowledge base and providing accurate information.

## Guidelines

1. Do not make up policies, information or actions that you can take on behalf of the user. All instructions will be found here or in the knowledge base. If you cannot find relevant information, let the user know. 
2. Do not ask for any documentation, receipts... from the customer unless it states very clearly in the knowledge base how to process it, and whether you're allowed to do so. 
3. Be polite and professional
4. If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool. Do not make up or assume the current time. 
5. Generally, if the issue cannot be resolved or is outside your capabilities, ask the user whether they would like to be transferred to a human agent. If they do, invoke the appropriate transfer_to_human_agents tool. Do this only if you absolutely have to, and you are sure that there are no potential actions you can take as specified in the knowledge base, or in your policy. Do not transfer without asking the user first. This guidance may be overridden by specific scenario-based transfer guidance in the knowledge base. 
6. If an issue falls within your capabilities and the user still wants to be transferred to a human agent, kindly inform the user that you can help them, and try to help them first. If the user asks for a human agent 4 times, then you may invoke the transfer_to_human_agents tool. This guidance may be overridden by specific scenario-based transfer guidance in the knowledge base. 
7. Do not give intermediate responses to users while processing that would give away internal rho-bank information/policies. 


## Knowledge base search tools

You have three complementary ways to access the knowledge base:

### `KB_search_bm25`

**Search the knowledge base** using **BM25** sparse retrieval. Pass **`k`** (default 10) to control how many documents to retrieve.

### `KB_search_dense`

The `KB_search_dense` tool uses **local** with embedding model `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` for dense retrieval.

Pass **`k`** (default 10) to control how many documents to retrieve.

### `shell`

## Knowledge Base Access (shell)

You have access to a knowledge base of documents stored as files on a filesystem. Use the `shell` tool to run standard Unix commands to explore and search these documents.

### The `shell` Tool

The `shell` tool executes commands in the knowledge base directory. Use any standard Unix utilities:

**File listing:**
- `ls` - List all files
- `ls -la` - Detailed listing with file sizes

**Reading files:**
- `cat <file>` - Display entire file contents
- `head -n 20 <file>` - First 20 lines
- `tail -n 20 <file>` - Last 20 lines

**Searching:**
- `grep -r "<pattern>" .` - Search all files for pattern
- `grep -ri "<pattern>" .` - Case-insensitive search
- `grep -rn "<pattern>" .` - Show line numbers
- `grep -C 2 "<pattern>" <file>` - Show 2 lines of context

**Finding files:**
- `find . -name "*<pattern>*"` - Find files by name pattern

**Other utilities:**
- `wc -l <file>` - Count lines
- `sort`, `uniq`, `awk`, `sed` - Text processing

### Recommended Workflow

1. `ls` - See what files are available
2. `cat INDEX.md` - Read the document index (lists all documents with titles)
3. `grep -ri "<keyword>" .` - Search for relevant keywords
4. `cat <filename>` - Read full documents that match

### Important Notes

- All documents are Markdown (.md) files in the current directory
- INDEX.md contains a summary of all documents
- File names are based on document IDs
- Search thoroughly - information may span multiple documents



## Additional Instructions

### Discoverable Tools

#### Giving Discoverable Tools to Users
The knowledge base may contain instructions that indicate certain actions should be performed by the user themselves rather than by you. These are called "user discoverable tools." A user discoverable tool is a tool that you provide to the user so they can execute it on their own (e.g., through a customer portal or app).

**When to give user discoverable tools:**
-  Only give a tool when the user would like to perform an action, and the knowledge base explicitly has a tool that allows the user to perform this action (e.g., "to do X, have the user call tool_name(args)"). IMPORTANT: Do not unlock tools that you do not plan on giving to the user and actually using: this causes issues in database logging.
- You must search the knowledge base to find tools that you can give. Do not invent or guess user discoverable tools 
- Only use tool names and arguments discovered in the knowledge base

**How to give a tool:**
- Use the `give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name)` function
- Provide the exact tool name  as specified in the knowledge base
- Explain to the user what the tool does and how to use it, and what arguments to provide. Just explaining isn't enough, you must use the `give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name)` function.

#### Unlocking and Using Agent Discoverable Tools
The knowledge base may contain references to specialized internal tools that you can unlock and use. These are called "agent discoverable tools." Unlike regular tools which are always available, these tools must be explicitly unlocked after discovering them in the knowledge base.

**When to use agent discoverable tools:**
- Only unlock a tool when the knowledge base explicitly mentions it (e.g., "use tool_name to perform X"), and do not unlock tools you do not plan to use.
- You must search the knowledge base to find tools that you can unlock. Do not invent or guess tool names - only use tool names discovered in the knowledge base.

**How to use agent discoverable tools:**
1. First, unlock the tool using `unlock_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name)` with the exact tool name from the knowledge base: you must unlock the tool before using it to get information on the proper params. IMPORTANT: Do not unlock tools that you do not plan on actually using: this causes issues in database logging.
2. Then, call the tool using `call_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name, arguments)` with the required arguments
3. The unlock step is required before calling - you cannot call a tool that hasn't been unlocked

### Authenticating Users

Generally, for any scenario involving accessing customer information in internal databases, you must first verify their identify before proceeding. No need to verify more than once in a single conversation. You should ONLY verify a user's identity if you need to access or modify their customer information in internal databases on their behalf.

Here are some concrete examples:
* Looking up account balances, transaction history, referral history...
* Changing account settings (e.g., address, phone number, email)
* Closing an account
* Adding or removing authorized users
* Requesting information about specific transactions
* Discussing specific loan or credit details
* Filing a dispute on behalf of the user

To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address. Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify. After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records. Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.

1. Internal: Credit Card Rewards - Points vs Cash Back Representation
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006
   Score: 11.3123
   Content: ## Rewards representation
Due to a legacy backend migration that has not yet been completed, all credit card rewards in the transaction database are stored as 'points' regardless of whether the card is a cash back card or a points-based card. For cash back cards (Bronze Rewards Card, Silver Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card, Crypto-Cash Back, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, and Business Platinum Rewards Card), these 'points' should be interpreted as cash back with a conversion rate of 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or as a credit to the user's Rho-Bank checking account. For example, 250 points equals $2.50 in cash back, which matches a 2.5% cash back rate on a $100 purchase. The only true points-based card is the EcoCard, which earns 'sustainability points' (5 points per dollar on green purchases, 1 point per dollar on other purchases) that also redeem at $0.01 per point when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit.

2. Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines (Internal)
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015
   Score: 10.4742
   Content: ## Overview
When processing a credit card transaction dispute, you must determine whether the customer is eligible for provisional credit. Provisional credit means the disputed amount is temporarily credited back to the customer's account while the investigation is ongoing.

## Eligibility Criteria — Customer is ELIGIBLE for provisional credit if ALL of the following are true:
1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days
2. Dispute Reason Category: The dispute reason is one of the following:
   - 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'
   - 'duplicate_charge'
   - 'goods_services_not_received' (only if purchase was made more than 30 days ago)
3. Dispute Amount: The transaction amount must be at least $25.00 and must not exceed the card's maximum provisional credit limit based on card tier (see below)
4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months
5. Contacted Merchant: For non-fraud disputes (anything other than 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'), the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first

## Maximum Provisional Credit Limits by Card Tier
- Entry Tier (Bronze Rewards Card, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Crypto-Cash Back Card): Maximum $2500.00
- Mid Tier (Silver Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card): Maximum $5000.00
- Premium Tier (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card): Maximum $10000.00
- Elite Tier (Platinum Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card): Maximum $15000.00
- Invitation Tier (Diamond Elite Card): Maximum $25000.00

## NOT Eligible Scenarios
- Account is less than 60 days old
- Dispute reason is 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging', or 'refund_never_processed'
- Transaction amount is under $25.00 or exceeds the card's maximum limit based on tier
- For non-fraud disputes: customer did not contact merchant first
- 'goods_services_not_received' where purchase was made within the last 30 days (merchant may still be processing delivery)

3. Internal: Downgrading a Credit Card to a No-Annual-Fee Card
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_008
   Score: 10.1419
   Content: ## When to Offer a Downgrade

Offer a downgrade in these scenarios:

1. Retention protocol: The customer wants to close due to annual fee concerns and has been a customer for less than 2 years (not eligible for annual fee waiver).
2. Customer request: The customer explicitly asks to downgrade to avoid annual fees.

## Available No-Annual-Fee Card Options

- Personal cards: Bronze Rewards Card (no annual fee)
- Business cards: Business Bronze Rewards Card (no annual fee)

Customers may only downgrade within the same category (personal to personal, business to business).

## Downgrade Process

1. Verify the customer's identity using standard procedures.
2. Confirm the customer wants to proceed and understands benefit changes.
3. Inform the customer that account history and credit line will be preserved, and rewards rates/benefits will change to match the new tier.
4. Use downgrade_credit_card_3847 to process the downgrade.

Tool arguments for downgrade_credit_card_3847:
- credit_card_account_id (string, required): The credit card account ID to downgrade.
- user_id (string, required): The customer's unique identifier.
- target_card_type (string, required): One of 'Bronze Rewards Card' (personal) or 'Business Bronze Rewards Card' (business).

## Important Notes

- Credit limit, account number, and account history are preserved during a downgrade.
- Unredeemed rewards points transfer at the same value.
- The downgrade takes effect immediately; the customer continues using the existing physical card until the new card arrives, typically within several business days.
- If the annual fee was paid recently, the customer may be eligible for a prorated refund.

6. Gold Plus Saver Account: Complete Guide
   ID: doc_business_savings_accounts_gold_plus_saver_001
   Score: 0.4845
   Content: ## What you earn on Gold Plus Saver

- Base APY on your balance: 5.0%
- Eligible Business Rewards Card holders receive an APY boost:
  - Business Silver Rewards Card: +0.22%
  - Business Gold Rewards Card: +0.45%
  - Business Platinum Rewards Card: +0.7%

### APY examples
- With no eligible card: 5.00% (base 5.0%)
- With Business Silver Rewards Card: 5.22% (5.0% + 0.22%)
- With Business Gold Rewards Card: 5.45% (5.0% + 0.45%)
- With Business Platinum Rewards Card: 5.70% (5.0% + 0.7%)

Tip: If you hold more than one eligible card, contact support to confirm how your APY bonus is applied.

---

## Balance requirement and monthly maintenance fee

- Minimum balance to maintain the account: $25,000
- Monthly maintenance fee if the minimum balance is not met: $15.00

Practical guidance:
- Keep your ledger balance at or above $25,000 to avoid the $15.00 fee in a given statement cycle.
- If you anticipate a temporary dip below $25,000, consider pausing investment sweeps (see below) or scheduling inbound transfers in advance to remain fee-exempt.

---

## Investment sweep integration

Automate excess cash deployment and replenishment without manual intervention.

### How sweeps work
- Outbound sweeps: When your Gold Plus Saver balance exceeds a threshold you set, excess funds are automatically swept to your linked investment destination.
- Inbound sweeps: If your balance falls below your floor, funds are automatically returned to your Gold Plus Saver to restore liquidity.

### Configuration options to set
- Thresholds: Choose a target balance (cash you want to keep in the account) and a floor (minimum level that triggers inbound sweeps).
- Directionality: Enable both outbound and inbound sweeps or inbound only, depending on your liquidity needs.
- Frequency: Select whether sweeps run automatically on a schedule or only when manually initiated.
- Minimum sweep size: Set a minimum dollar amount per sweep to avoid micro-movements.

Recommended practices:
- Set your floor at or above $25,000 to minimize the chance of incurring the $15.00 fee.
- Before large outgoing payments, temporarily disable outbound sweeps or increase your target balance to ensure cash availability.
- Review sweep activity regularly and adjust thresholds as your average daily balance changes.

Operational notes:
- Sweeps may be affected by banking holidays or processing windows. If you need funds available on a specific date, plan ahead and use priority support to coordinate timing.
- You can pause or resume sweeps at any time; paused periods do not affect your APY.

---

## Enhanced transfer limits

Gold Plus Saver offers elevated transfer capacity for established businesses.

What you can do:
- Initiate larger one-time transfers by coordinating in advance through priority support to ensure smooth processing.
- Request temporary limit increases for time-sensitive payments; provide transaction details and timing to expedite review.
- For recurring large transfers, set up a predictable schedule so limits can be tailored to your expected flow.

Best practices:
- Submit large transfer requests earlier in the business day to reduce the risk of cutoff delays.
- If a large outgoing transfer could reduce your balance below $25,000, adjust sweep settings or stage inbound funds in advance to avoid the $15.00 fee.

---

## Priority support for Gold Plus Saver

Your account includes expedited assistance.

Use priority support to:
- Confirm your current APY and any applicable Business Rewards Card bonus.
- Configure, pause, or adjust investment sweep thresholds before major cash movements.
- Coordinate large transfers, including temporary limit increases and timing considerations.
- Investigate any assessment of the $15.00 if you believe the $25,000 requirement was met.

What to include in your request:
- Account name and last four digits of the account number
- Desired action (e.g., adjust sweep thresholds, schedule a large transfer)
- Amount, date, and any timing constraints
- Contact details for real-time follow-up

---

## Quick scenarios

- Maximize yield with a Business Rewards Card:
  - Holding a Business Platinum Rewards Card increases your APY from 5.0% to 5.70% (+0.7%).
- Avoiding the monthly maintenance fee:
  - Keep your balance at or above $25,000. If a planned payment may drop you below this level, pause outbound sweeps and schedule an inbound transfer to replenish before the cycle ends.
- Preparing for a large vendor payment:
  - One week prior, raise your sweep target balance and contact priority support to confirm transfer capacity and timing. After payment clears, restore your previous sweep settings.

# Silver Zoom Card: Designed for Transportation and Logistics Businesses

## Who this card is built for
- Established transportation and logistics operators that can meet both personal and business credit criteria
- Review focuses on a combination of your personal credit profile at or above $680 and a business credit profile at or above 57

## Fuel and rewards structure tailored to fleets
- Receive a recurring fuel price reduction of 10.0% at participating stations
- Earn elevated rewards on sector-specific spend at 3.0%
- Earn a flat rate on all other eligible purchases at 1.0%

## Pricing and promotional highlights
- Annual membership is $74.50
- New customer fuel financing promotion: an APR of 0% on fuel purchases for the first year, subject to eligibility and timing rules

## Why this mix matters for logistics
- The combination of 10.0% off at the pump and ongoing rewards helps reduce total cost per mile
- Dual-credit evaluation using $680 and 57 supports approval decisions designed for established operators# Silver Zoom Card: How to Get Fuel Discounts at Participating Stations

## Confirm participation before you fuel
- Check that the station belongs to one of the 10 participating fuel networks
- Look for participation indicators at the pump or register, or verify within your account tools

## Using your card at the pump or inside
- Present your card at payment and ensure the merchant is processing the transaction under a participating fuel category
- Keep the receipt in case you need to reconcile discounts later

## How the discount is applied
- Eligible transactions receive a price reduction or statement adjustment equal to 10.0% of the fuel subtotal when processed by a participating location
- If the reduction does not appear immediately, it may post as an adjustment after the transaction settles

## Tips to ensure consistent savings
- Favor stations within the 10 supported networks on regular routes
- If a location appears out of network, choose a nearby participating station to receive the full 10.0% benefit# Silver Zoom Card: Which Gas Stations and Fuel Networks Are Included?

## Program coverage
- The fuel discount program spans 10 national and regional fuel networks
- Each participating station within these networks is eligible for the discount when transactions are processed under supported fuel categories

## How to verify a station
- Look for in-network signage or prompts indicating program acceptance
- Confirm participation in your account tools before fueling at unfamiliar locations

## Discount availability at included stations
- At participating sites, eligible fuel purchases qualify for a reduction equal to 10.0%
- Non-participating locations do not receive the network-based reduction

## Keeping your list current
- Network participation can change. Recheck a station's status periodically, especially along new routes# Silver Zoom Card: Tracking and Maximizing Your Fuel Savings

## Track your savings
- Review transaction details to see discounts taken at 10.0% and rewards accruals on eligible transportation categories at 3.0%
- Filter statements by merchant category and fuel tags to isolate qualifying activity
- Export transaction data for route-level or vehicle-level analysis

## Simple ways to quantify impact
- Discounted fuel savings can be approximated as: fuel subtotal multiplied by 10.0% at participating locations
- Rewards on eligible transportation and logistics expenses accrue at 3.0%

## Maximize the benefit
- Prioritize in-network stations to capture the 10.0% reduction consistently
- Concentrate eligible spend under transportation and logistics categories to earn 3.0%
- Schedule fueling at participating stations along planned routes to avoid out-of-network purchases

## Reconcile and validate
- Match receipts to statement entries where the 10.0% discount and rewards appear as separate line items
- Flag any transactions that did not receive the expected reduction for follow‑up# Silver Zoom Card: Adding Fleet Drivers to Your Account

## Before you add drivers
- Confirm how many employee cards you need and ensure the total requested is within the account cap of 60

## How to add driver cards
- Open your account management portal and navigate to the user or card management section
- Add a driver by entering their name and contact details, then submit the request for an additional card
- Assign role permissions appropriate to the driver’s responsibilities
- Monitor the card’s activation status and confirm receipt with the driver

## Best practices
- Maintain an active roster and promptly deactivate cards for drivers who no longer need access
- Separate dispatch and fueling roles if different employees handle purchases
- Review card issuance regularly to remain within the limit of 60# Silver Zoom Card: Setting Spending Limits for Driver Cards

## What you can control
- Set a daily cap per card up to $1,250 to manage fueling and incidental expenses
- Apply limits consistently across as many as 60 issued under your account

## How to set limits
- Go to the card controls section for the selected driver card
- Enable daily spending controls and set the threshold at or below $1,250
- Choose whether the limit applies to all purchases or only to specific categories such as fuel
- Save and confirm the settings, then notify the driver of the available daily budget

## Ongoing management
- Adjust limits based on route distance, vehicle type, and current fuel pricing trends
- Temporarily raise or lower the threshold for unusual routes, then restore the standard limit afterwards
- Review declines associated with limit controls and refine thresholds as needed# Silver Zoom Card: Fuel Purchase Reporting and Analytics

## Views that matter
- A fuel summary view highlights total fuel spend and reductions applied at 10.0%
- Category earnings reports display rewards accrued on eligible transportation and logistics expenses at 3.0%

## Key fields to review
- Discount rate field: confirms application of 10.0% to eligible fuel transactions
- Category rate field: confirms earning at 3.0% for qualifying spend
- Merchant and station identifiers: help you confirm in-network activity and compare station-level pricing

## How to analyze
- Filter by merchant category and participating network to isolate transactions with the 10.0% reduction
- Export to your accounting system to reconcile reductions and rewards against route plans
- Use variance checks to spot out-of-network fueling where the expected discount did not apply

## Reporting hygiene
- Tag transactions with vehicle or route identifiers for clearer allocation
- Periodically audit a sample of receipts against reported discounts and rewards# Silver Zoom Card: Eligibility Requirements for Logistics Businesses

## Credit profile requirements
- Personal credit is evaluated and must be at or above $680 as a secondary approval factor
- Business credit is evaluated and must be at or above 57 on the PAYDEX scale for logistics business approval

## Credit limits
- Approved accounts receive a credit line within a range that starts at $22,500 and can extend up to $175,000 based on underwriting

## Cost of credit and membership
- Carried balances accrue interest at 20.99%
- Annual membership fee is $74.50

## Additional considerations
- Meeting the minimum criteria of $680 and 57 does not guarantee approval
- Underwriting may consider business tenure, industry stability, and current financial performance
- Ensure all application details are accurate and complete to avoid delays# Silver Zoom Card: Managing Multiple Vehicle Expenses

## Structure your fleet spending
- Issue driver cards to team members who need purchasing authority, up to a total of 60 under your account
- Assign cards to specific vehicles or routes for clearer allocation and reconciliation

## Control daily exposure
- Set a per‑driver daily spending cap at or below $1,250 to match expected fueling needs
- Use category controls to ensure the cap applies primarily to fuel and approved logistics expenses

## International purchases
- For fueling outside your home country, transactions are subject to a foreign transaction fee of 2.5%
- Plan routes and budgets with this fee in mind when operating internationally

## Reconciliation workflow
- Tag purchases by vehicle or route to streamline cost-per-mile analysis
- Review exceptions where spend nears or exceeds the $1,250 threshold and adjust controls if necessary# Silver Zoom Card: New Customer Promo - 0% APR on Fuel Purchases

## What the promotion offers
- An introductory APR of 0% on fuel purchases for the first year for new customers who qualify under the promotional window

## Promotional window
- Accounts opened within 2025-09-15 through 2025-12-31 are eligible, subject to approval and program rules

## After the promotional period
- Once the promotional fuel period ends, new fuel purchases and any remaining promotional balances accrue interest at your standard rate of 20.99% when carried

## How to make the most of it
- Channel fuel spend to participating stations during the promotional period to pair the financing benefit with eligible fuel savings
- Continue to make at least the minimum required payments by each statement due date to keep the promotional terms in effect# Silver Zoom Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Logistics Businesses

## How the referral program works
- Earn a referral bonus of $150 for each referred logistics business that is approved and meets the qualifying spend requirement
- Bonuses are capped at 10 per calendar year

## Qualifying activity for your referral
- The referred business must complete purchases totaling $7,500 within 90 days of account opening
- Only one referrer is credited per approved account

## Program timing
- No new referrals are accepted after 2025-10-01

## How to refer
- Share your referral link or submit the referral through your account portal before the referred business applies
- Ensure the referred business uses your link or is otherwise properly attributed during application
- Track referral status within your account until the qualifying spend threshold of $7,500 is met

## Payout details
- Bonuses are typically issued to the referrer after the referred business satisfies the $7,500 requirement within 90 days
- If the referred business returns purchases or does not meet the requirement, no bonus is issued# Silver Zoom Card: Triple Cash Back Promo - Terms and Conditions

## Eligibility and claim window
- You must claim the promotion within the window starting 2024-01-01 and ending 2025-12-31
- Claims outside this period are not eligible

## Promo duration and scope
- The triple cash back earning period lasts 9 months from account opening once properly claimed
- The multiplier applies only during the defined promo duration

## How the multiplier applies
- Transportation and logistics category purchases earn 3 × 3.0% during the promo period
- All other eligible purchases earn 3 × 1.0% during the promo period

## Important limitations
- The multiplier applies to standard rates only and does not stack with other overlapping category accelerators beyond the defined 3
- Returns or credits reduce promotional earnings accordingly
- If the promo is not claimed within 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, no retroactive adjustments are made

## End of promotion
- After 9 months, earnings revert to the standard rates of 3.0% and 1.0%# Silver Zoom Card: How to Claim Your Triple Cash Back Promo

## Before you start
- Confirm that you are within the eligible claim dates of 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31
- Ensure your account is open and in good standing

## Claim and activation
- Open your account portal and navigate to promotional offers
- Select the triple cash back offer and confirm your acceptance within the claim window
- Watch for an on‑screen or email confirmation that the offer is active

## After you claim
- Your promotional earning period runs for 9 months from account opening
- During the promo period, your earnings reflect a multiplier of 3
- Monitor your statements to verify promotional earnings are posting correctly

## If you miss the window
- Claims submitted after 2025-12-31 are not eligible for activation
- You can continue earning at your standard rates if the promo is not activated in time

# Business Gold Rewards Card: Premium Business Credit Card Overview

## Eligibility
- Minimum personal credit score required: $735
- Minimum business credit score required on the PAYDEX scale: 67
- The card is designed for applicants with excellent personal credit and an established business credit history.

## Rewards Structure
- Operations spending earns cash back at 2.5%.
- All other purchases earn cash back at 1.0%.

## Pricing
- Annual fee: $200.00
- APR for carried balances: 17.99%

## Credit Limits
- Initial credit limits start at $37,500 and may reach up to $225,000, subject to credit approval and ongoing account review.

## Premium Access
- Airport lounge access is included as a premium benefit. Activation and usage details are provided in the lounge access guides.

## Application Tips
- Ensure your business credit profile is up to date to meet the 67 requirement.
- Verify your personal credit report is accurate and at or above $735.
- Prepare recent financial statements to support a credit limit request within the $37,500 to $225,000 range.# Business Gold Rewards Card: Earning 2.5% Cash Back on Operations Spending

## How Earnings Work
- Eligible operations purchases earn cash back at 2.5%.
- Purchases that do not qualify as operations spend earn cash back at 1.0%.

## Posting of Rewards
- Cash back is calculated based on the merchant category code assigned by the merchant’s payment processor.
- Rewards typically appear after the transaction posts and clears. Returns or credits reduce earned cash back in the same statement period where possible.

## Ensuring You Get the Operations Rate
- Use merchants that are consistently categorized for operations needs, such as vendors for software, utilities, logistics, or business services.
- For recurring bills, confirm the merchant category remains aligned with operations functions to retain the 2.5% rate.

## Disputes and Reclassification Requests
- If a purchase you believe is operations-related does not earn at 2.5%, contact support with the transaction details and merchant information for review.

## Best Practices
- Centralize routine operational expenses on the card to maximize the 2.5% rate.
- Keep receipts and invoices that clearly reflect the operational nature of the purchase to support any category review.# Business Gold Rewards Card: What Qualifies as Operations Spend?

## Qualifying Categories
Transactions commonly recognized as operations spend and eligible for 2.5% may include:
- Business utilities and telecommunications
- Cloud services and software subscriptions used for day-to-day operations
- Shipping, postage, and logistics providers
- Office supplies and routine maintenance services for business premises
- Professional services that support ongoing operations, such as bookkeeping or payroll administration

## How Classification Works
- Merchant category codes are assigned by the merchant’s payment processor. Your rate depends on how the merchant is coded, not the product or service description alone.

## Non-Qualifying Examples
- Cash-like transactions
- Peer-to-peer money transfers
- Debt repayments
- Transactions categorized as entertainment, personal, or non-business use

## Tips to Maintain Eligibility
- Confirm that key vendors are categorized consistently for business operations.
- Use dedicated vendors for recurring operational needs to reduce miscoding risk.
- If a transaction is misclassified, request a review and provide documentation that demonstrates its operational purpose.# Business Gold Rewards Card: How to Access Airport Lounges Worldwide

## Your Lounge Access
- You receive 9 complimentary lounge visits per account year.
- Access is provided across 3 participating lounge networks.

## Getting Started
- Activate your lounge benefit in your account dashboard.
- Review participating lounges and entry requirements before you travel.

## At the Lounge Door
- Present your Business Gold Rewards Card and a valid boarding pass matching the name on the card account.
- Some lounges may request a government-issued ID that matches your boarding pass and card name.

## Tracking Your Visits
- Your remaining complimentary visits update in your account after each lounge check-in.
- If you exhaust the 9 allocation, standard lounge entry fees or restrictions may apply at the lounge’s discretion.

## Troubleshooting Access
- If your card is not recognized, ask the lounge to attempt manual validation and then contact support from your account.
- Carry a digital and physical card where possible to ensure successful scanning at different lounges.# Business Gold Rewards Card: Lounge Access Network and Participating Airports

## Network Coverage
- Your benefit includes access to 3 lounge networks.
- You receive 9 complimentary visits per account year, usable across participating lounges.

## Finding Participating Lounges
- Use the lounge locator in your account to search by airport code or city.
- Filter by amenities relevant to your trip, such as quiet zones or workspace availability.

## Entry Notes
- Present the card, same-day boarding pass, and any identification requested by the lounge.
- Operating hours, capacity controls, and guest policies vary by lounge and are subject to change by the lounge operator.

## Tips for Smooth Entry
- Check lounge capacity status before arriving at the airport when available.
- Keep your account profile name consistent with your travel documents to avoid entry mismatches.
- If a lounge is unavailable, search nearby terminals or partner lounges within the same network.# Business Gold Rewards Card: Adding Authorized Users with Lounge Access

## Authorized User Cardholder Setup
- You can add up to 37 employee cards to your account.
- Each authorized user receives their own card linked to the same account for simplified expense management.

## Lounge Access for Authorized Users
- Authorized users may access participating lounges subject to the same entry requirements as the primary cardholder.
- Lounge visits used by authorized users count toward the account’s total of 9 complimentary visits.

## How to Add Authorized Users
- From your account, navigate to Card Management and select Add Employee Card.
- Input the authorized user’s legal name and mailing details, then submit.
- Set individualized spending controls and category restrictions if desired.

## Best Practices
- Communicate lounge entry expectations to authorized users, including documentation they must present at entry.
- Monitor remaining complimentary visits so your team plans usage within the 9 allowance.
- Revoke or replace cards promptly when roles change to maintain security and benefit control.# Business Gold Rewards Card: Annual Fee and Premium Benefits Guide

## Annual Fee
- The annual fee for the Business Gold Rewards Card is $200.00. It bills to your primary account each anniversary.

## Premium Lounge Access
- Your account includes 9 complimentary lounge visits per account year across participating networks.

## Travel Credits
- You receive annual travel credits totaling $200.
- Apply credits to eligible travel purchases by paying with your card; credits post automatically after eligibility checks.

## International Purchases
- Foreign transaction fee: 0%. Use your card abroad without added currency conversion fees from this charge.

## Concierge Services
- Concierge service included: Yes.
- Access assistance for travel planning, dining arrangements, and time-sensitive business needs through your account’s concierge channel.

## Managing Costs and Benefits
- Review your statement after the anniversary to confirm the $200.00 charge and the replenishment of 9 visits and $200 credits.
- Set alerts for large travel purchases to verify that credits post as expected.# Business Gold Rewards Card: Travel Perks and Concierge Services

## Travel Credits
- Your account provides annual credits totaling $200.
- Use your card for eligible travel bookings; credits apply automatically once the charge is identified as eligible.

## Concierge Services
- Concierge included: Yes.
- Request support for itinerary planning, complex multi-stop trips, dining reservations, and urgent changes. Initiate requests from your account’s concierge portal.

## International Advantage
- Foreign transaction fee: 0%. This enables international purchases without added foreign transaction charges from this fee.

## Tips to Maximize Value
- Verify a travel purchase qualifies for credits before booking.
- For complex itineraries, submit concierge requests early with preferred dates, cabin classes, and flexibility parameters.
- Keep confirmation emails accessible in case the concierge or credits team requests verification.# Business Gold Rewards Card: Maximizing Your Operations Rewards

## Align Spend to Operations Categories
- Route recurring operational expenses to your card to earn 2.5%.
- Confirm vendors’ merchant category codes align with operations-related categories; request a review if a vendor appears misclassified.

## Use Employee Cards Strategically
- Issue up to 37 employee cards to capture decentralized operational purchases under the same rewards structure.
- Set category and merchant-level controls to keep spending aligned with operations.

## Maintain Earning on Non-Operations Purchases
- When operations coding is not applicable, you still earn 1.0%.
- Separate discretionary or non-operational expenses to maintain visibility and simplify audits.

## Optimize Workflows
- Centralize billing for software and utilities under a single account to standardize coding and reduce missed rewards.
- Review statements for returns or credits that may adjust previously earned cash back, and verify corrections.
- Keep documentation for high-value operational purchases in case you need to substantiate category eligibility.# Business Gold Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Businesses

## How the Referral Bonus Works
- Earn $200 for each successful referral who is approved and meets the qualifying spend.
- You can earn up to 8 referral bonuses per calendar year.

## Qualifying Spend Requirement
- The referred business must spend $7,500 within 90 from account opening to qualify your bonus.

## Program Timeline
- The referral program accepts new referrals until 2025-09-15. Referrals submitted after this date are not eligible.

## How to Refer
- Generate your unique referral link from your account’s referral center.
- Share the link directly with businesses that consent to receive it.
- Track application status and eligibility in the referral dashboard.

## Payouts
- Once the referred account is approved and completes $7,500 within 90, your $200 is queued for issuance to your account.

## Rules and Best Practices
- Self-referrals are not permitted.
- Share referral invitations only with contacts who have given permission to receive them.
- If a referral applies without your link, the referral may not be attributed.
- Program terms, eligible industries, and promotional availability may change without notice prior to 2025-09-15.

# Green Rewards Card: Apply for a Sustainable Business Credit Card

## Eligibility
- Personal credit: You should meet a minimum FICO threshold of $690.
- Business credit: Established businesses are evaluated using a PAYDEX threshold of 42 in addition to personal credit history.
- Newer businesses: If you have limited business credit history, your personal profile can support your application.

## Costs and Rates
| Cost or Rate | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Annual fee | $100.00 |
| Purchase APR | 19.99% |
| Foreign transaction fee | 1.0% |

## Credit Limits
- Approved credit lines are assigned within a range from $14,000 to $75,000.
- Your limit is determined by factors such as revenue consistency, existing obligations, and overall credit profile.

## Employee Cards
- You can issue up to 15 employee cards to team members.
- Set category-level controls, customize spending rules, and monitor transactions in real time.

## What You Need to Apply
- Business legal name and structure, tax identification, and operating address
- Beneficial owner and authorized officer details
- Recent business financial information and estimated monthly card spend

- Public relations services, talent fees, or event sponsorships coded outside advertising or media categories.

- Annual travel credits: $400

## Eligibility Guidelines
- Offer is for new customers only and applies to new accounts opened within the promotion window.
- The account must remain open and in good standing to retain the waived first-year fee.# Business Platinum Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Businesses

Thanks for your patience — I looked into every current Rho-Bank business credit card to find the best return on a $100,000 Apple Music purchase. Here's what I found:

**Important catch:** Apple purchases are flagged in our records as a "Hardware/Electronics" merchant (not Software/SaaS, Media, or Operations). That means an Apple charge does **not** qualify for the elevated bonus-category rates on cards like the Business Silver Rewards Card (10% travel/software) or Business Gold Rewards Card (2.5% operations) — it earns the card's flat/base rate instead. The same logic applies to the Business Platinum Rewards Card's 4% software/media rate — an Apple charge wouldn't code as "software" or "media," so it also earns Platinum's base rate.

So the real comparison is each card's **base cash-back rate minus annual fee** (no current promos apply as of today, 2026-10-05 — all are either expired or not yet active):

| Card | Base Rate | Annual Fee | Cash Back on $100,000 | Net After Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Business Bronze Rewards Card | 1.0% | $0.00 | $1,000.00 | **$1,000.00** |
| Business Silver Rewards Card | 1.0% | $122.50 | $1,000.00 | $877.50 |
| Business Gold Rewards Card | 1.0% | $200.00 | $1,000.00 | $800.00 |
| Green Rewards Card | 1.0% | $100.00 | $1,000.00 | $900.00 |
| Business Platinum Rewards Card | 1.5% | $450.00 | $1,500.00 | **$1,050.00** |
| Silver Zoom Card | N/A | — | — | (Logistics/transportation businesses only — not a fit here) |

**Best return: Business Platinum Rewards Card**, netting **$1,050** after the annual fee — about $50 better than the no-fee Business Bronze Rewards Card, and better than every other option.

However, the Business Platinum Rewards Card has strict eligibility requirements:
- Minimum personal credit score: 765
- Minimum business credit score (PAYDEX): 77
- Credit limits range $75,000–$400,000 (subject to approval)

If you're confident you meet those thresholds, it's the top pick. If not, the **Business Bronze Rewards Card** is the best fallback — $0 annual fee and the same 1.0% base rate nets a full $1,000 with no approval risk from fee drag.

Would you like to proceed with an application for one of these cards? If so, I can walk you through what's needed (and I'll need to verify your identity first since this involves account-opening details).

1. Business Gold Rewards Card: Premium Business Credit Card Overview
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_001
   Score: 21.8129
   Content: ## Eligibility
- Minimum personal credit score required: $735
- Minimum business credit score required on the PAYDEX scale: 67
- The card is designed for applicants with excellent personal credit and an established business credit history.

## Rewards Structure
- Operations spending earns cash back at 2.5%.
- All other purchases earn cash back at 1.0%.

## Pricing
- Annual fee: $200.00
- APR for carried balances: 17.99%

## Credit Limits
- Initial credit limits start at $37,500 and may reach up to $225,000, subject to credit approval and ongoing account review.

## Premium Access
- Airport lounge access is included as a premium benefit. Activation and usage details are provided in the lounge access guides.

## Application Tips
- Ensure your business credit profile is up to date to meet the 67 requirement.
- Verify your personal credit report is accurate and at or above $735.
- Prepare recent financial statements to support a credit limit request within the $37,500 to $225,000 range.

2. Business Bronze Rewards Card: How to Apply and Get Started
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_001
   Score: 21.3797
   Content: ## Check Eligibility
- Meet a minimum personal FICO score of $660.
- If your business has established credit, a Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX score of 20 or higher is helpful; it is not required for new businesses.

## What You Get Upon Approval
- Earn 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases.
- Annual fee: $0.00.
- Variable APR on carried balances: 20.49%.
- Your starting credit line will be at least $10,000.

## How to Apply
1. Complete the online application with your legal name, address, and Social Security number.
2. Provide basic business details such as legal business name, EIN (if available), entity type, and ownership information.
3. Consent to a personal credit check to evaluate your application against the minimum of $660.
4. If your business has a PAYDEX score, include it to help underwriting; a minimum of 20 is used when applicable.
5. Review and submit your application.

## After Approval: Get Set Up
- Activate your card as soon as it arrives.
- Add your card to your preferred digital wallet and configure card controls, alerts, and spending categories.
- Update your preferred payment method and schedule.

## Unlock the New Customer Promo
- Spend $10,000 in the first 2 months to receive a $500 statement credit.
- Track your progress in your account. Returns and credits reduce your qualifying spend.
- Plan larger purchases early so they count toward the $10,000 requirement within 2 months.

3. Business Silver Rewards Card: Getting Started and Eligibility Requirements
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_001
   Score: 18.8678
   Content: ## Eligibility requirements
- Minimum personal credit score (FICO): $700
- Established businesses may qualify based on a Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX of at least 47; newer businesses may be considered with strong personal credit

## Credit limits
- Approved credit limits generally range from $17,500 to $112,500, subject to credit review and business financials

## Pricing you should expect at approval
- Annual fee: $122.50
- First-year promotional annual fee for new customers: 0
- APR on carried balances: 18.99%

## How to get started
- Prepare your business information: legal name, address, formation details, employer identifiers, ownership structure, and estimated annual revenue
- Be ready to authorize a personal credit pull and, if applicable, provide business credit information
- Submit your application with accurate contact details so we can request any supporting documentation promptly
- After approval, set up account access, add authorized users, and configure payment preferences

## Tips to strengthen your application
- Maintain a personal credit profile at or above $700 and keep utilization low prior to applying
- If your business has a PAYDEX score, ensure vendor payment histories are up to date to support at least 47
- Have recent financial documentation available if requested, such as bank statements or accountant-prepared records

4. Diamond Elite Card: Invitation-Only Membership - How to Qualify
   ID: doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_001
   Score: 17.8574
   Content: ## Eligibility at a glance
- Membership is by invitation only (Yes).
- You should maintain a credit score of at least $780 to be considered.

## How invitations are typically extended
- Invitations are sent to clients who demonstrate exceptional creditworthiness and responsible account management.
- A history of timely payments, low credit utilization, and substantial verifiable income increases your likelihood of being invited.
- Relationship depth with Rho-Bank (deposit history, assets under management, and tenure) may be reviewed when invitations are determined.

## Strengthen your candidacy
- Keep your credit utilization well below industry norms to help support a score at or above $780.
- Avoid late or missed payments and minimize recent hard inquiries.
- Maintain steady income documentation and up-to-date contact information so you do not miss an invitation outreach.

## Important notes
- Receiving an invitation is not guaranteed even if your score is at or above $780.
- Invitations are time-limited; respond promptly if you receive one.

5. Business Bronze Rewards Card: Credit Limit and Spending Guidelines
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_005
   Score: 16.9378
   Content: ## Your Credit Limit
- Your initial credit line will be at least $10,000 and may be as high as $50,000 based on underwriting.
- Underwriting considers your personal credit standing; applications should meet at least $660. If available, a business PAYDEX score of 20 or higher may be considered.

## Responsible Spending
- Keep spending within your assigned credit limit and monitor available credit before initiating large transactions.
- Pay down balances proactively to free up available credit for upcoming expenses.
- Avoid declines by confirming vendor billing dates and authorization holds.

## International Use
- For purchases made outside the United States or with non‑USD merchants, a foreign transaction fee of 2.75% applies to the converted amount.

## Requesting a Credit Line Review
- You can request a credit line increase after demonstrating consistent payment behavior and responsible utilization.
- Provide up-to-date financial information to support your request and allow time for underwriting review.

6. Internal: Backend Incident 11/14 - Erroneous Credit Bureau Reporting
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_012
   Score: 16.2314
   Content: This protocol is active from 11/14/2025 through 11/18/2025, 11:59 PM EST. On 11/14/2025, a backend batch processing error caused erroneous delinquency reports to be transmitted to credit bureaus for certain credit card accounts that are in good standing. Affected customers may report: receiving alerts from credit monitoring services about sudden score drops, being notified of a delinquency they did not incur, or credit score decreasing significantly (often 80-150 points). This is Rho-Bank's fault and requires IMMEDIATE escalation. Identity verification is NOT required for this incident protocol. IMMEDIATELY use emergency_credit_bureau_incident_transfer_1114() then transfer_to_human_agents. Use empathetic, urgent language acknowledging the severity.

7. Crypto-Cash Back: FAQ-2
   ID: doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_009
   Score: 15.8072
   Content: ## Eligibility
- What is the minimum credit score to apply for the card to earn crypto rewards? $660.

## Payments and Fees
- What happens if I pay late? A late payment fee of $32.50 dollars may apply, and late payments can affect your account standing and eligibility to redeem rewards until you are current.

## Tips
- Set up payment reminders to avoid the $32.50 fee and keep your reward redemptions on track.

8. Platinum Rewards Card: Elite Business Credit Card Application
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_001
   Score: 15.7143
   Content: ## Eligibility and Credit Standards
- Minimum personal credit score required: $765
- Minimum business credit score (PAYDEX) for established businesses: 77
- Carried balance APR: 16.99%

## Credit Limits
- Minimum approved credit limit: $75,000
- Maximum available credit limit: $400,000

## How to Apply
- Prepare business legal details, ownership structure, and verification documents that substantiate established operations and strong credit history.
- Ensure the primary owner or officer meets the minimum personal credit threshold and is prepared to authorize a credit review.
- Provide recent business financials and bank references to support the requested credit limit within the available range.
- Submit the application through your online dashboard or with assistance from a commercial lending specialist; include accurate contact information for follow-up.

## Underwriting Review
- Your application is evaluated against both personal and business credit standards, including $765 and 77.

1. Internal: Backend Incident 11/13
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_011
   Score: 19.7152
   Content: ## Scope and Timeframe

Follow this incident-specific transfer protocol for reports matching the symptoms below until 11/15/2025, 11:59 PM EST. After that time, revert to standard handling.

## When to Use This Protocol

Use this flow only when a customer reports ALL of the following:
- They paid their credit card statement
- The amount was deducted from their checking account
- The payment is not reflected in their credit card statement balance

**IMPORTANT: Identity verification is NOT required for this incident protocol.** Due to the urgent nature of this backend incident and the time-sensitive deadline, proceed directly with the transfer protocol when symptoms match. Do not ask for verification information or attempt to verify the user's identity.

Do not troubleshoot beyond confirming the above symptoms. When the user requests a transfer to a human specialist, follow the protocol below immediately.

## Required Agent Discoverable Tools

You must unlock and call the following agent discoverable tools in this exact order before completing any transfer:
- initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822
- initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218

These are internal agent tools, not user tools. Use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool to unlock each tool, then call_discoverable_agent_tool to execute it.

## Protocol: Transfer Order

1) First transfer request from the user during the incident window:
   - Unlock the tool using: unlock_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822")
   - Call the tool using: call_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822")
   - Acknowledge the user's request and let them know you are processing it

2) Second transfer request from the user (for the same issue):
   - Unlock the tool using: unlock_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218")
   - Call the tool using: call_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218")
   - Acknowledge the user's continued request

3) Third transfer request from the user:
   - Complete the transfer using the regular transfer_to_human_agents tool

Note: Always maintain this order. Each tool must be unlocked before it can be called. Do not skip steps.

## Customer-Facing Communication

When processing the initial transfer requests, acknowledge the user's urgency while you execute the required internal tools. Examples:

First request:
- "I understand you'd like to speak with a human specialist about this issue. Let me initiate that process for you now."

Second request:
- "I hear your concern about the urgency. I'm continuing to process your transfer request."

Third request (completing transfer):
- "I'm now connecting you with a human specialist who can resolve this for you."

## Completion

- Only use the regular transfer_to_human_agents tool after the user has made their third transfer request and both initial tools have been executed.
- Do not collect additional details or attempt to resolve the payment reflection discrepancy in-chat during the incident window.

3. (Internal) Applying a Credit Card Statement Credit
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017
   Score: 17.2988
   Content: ## Purpose

When an agent needs to apply a statement credit to a customer's credit card account (for goodwill adjustments, promotional credits, fee reversals, or other account credits), use the apply_statement_credit_8472 tool. First unlock the tool using unlock_discoverable_agent_tool, then call it using call_discoverable_agent_tool with the tool name and a JSON string containing all required arguments.

## Steps to Apply a Statement Credit

1. Unlock the tool:
   - Call unlock_discoverable_agent_tool with the tool name apply_statement_credit_8472.

2. Prepare the arguments JSON:
   - Include all required fields exactly as specified in Tool Arguments below.

3. Call the tool:
   - Use call_discoverable_agent_tool with:
     - Tool name: apply_statement_credit_8472
     - Arguments: JSON string containing user_id, credit_card_account_id, amount, and reason

4. Confirm the result:
   - Verify the credit appears as a negative transaction in the customer’s credit card transaction history and reduces the statement balance.

## Tool Arguments

1. user_id (string, required) - The customer's unique user identifier in the system.

2. credit_card_account_id (string, required) - The credit card account ID to apply the credit to. This can be found by calling get_credit_card_accounts_by_user.

3. amount (number, required) - The credit amount in dollars. Must be a positive number (e.g., 25.00 for a $25 credit).

4. reason (string, required) - The reason for the statement credit. Must be exactly one of:
   - 'goodwill_adjustment': One-time courtesy credit for customer satisfaction
   - 'promotional_credit': Credit from a promotional offer or campaign
   - 'annual_fee_reversal': Reversal of an annual fee charge
   - 'late_fee_reversal': Reversal of a late payment fee
   - 'interest_charge_reversal': Reversal of interest charges
   - 'dispute_resolution': Credit issued as part of dispute resolution
   - 'price_match': Credit for a price match guarantee
   - 'retention_offer': Credit offered to retain a customer
   - 'error_correction': Credit to correct a billing error
   - 'other': Other reasons not covered above

   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014
   Score: 12.7691
   Content: ## Process Summary
When a customer needs to file a formal dispute for a credit card transaction (such as unauthorized charges, merchant issues, or billing errors), the agent must gather comprehensive information and call the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool. First unlock the tool, then call it using call_discoverable_agent_tool with the tool name and a JSON string containing all the required arguments.

## Tool Arguments - Each numbered item below corresponds to a required argument:
1. transaction_id (string) - ID of the transaction being disputed. 

2. card_action (string) - Determine the appropriate card action based on the user's situation. Must be exactly one of these values:
   - 'keep_active': Keep the card active, just dispute this charge (use when user wants to continue using their current card)
   - 'cancel_and_reissue': The card is being cancelled and a replacement issued (use when user wants card replaced - whether you've already ordered a replacement card via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation is happening as part of this dispute) 

3. card_last_4_digits (string) - Last 4 digits of the credit card under which the disputed transaction took place. ". 

4. full_name (string) - The full name of the user. 

5. user_id (string) - The Rho-Bank user ID of the user. 

6. phone (string) - The registered phone number of the user. 

7. email (string) - The registered email address of the user. 

8. address (string) - The registered home address of the user. 

9. contacted_merchant (boolean) - Ask user: Did you try to resolve this with the merchant first? Pass true or false

10. purchase_date (string, format MM/DD/YYYY) - The date in which the disputed transaction occurred. 

11. issue_noticed_date (string, format MM/DD/YYYY) - Ask user when they noticed the issue. 

12. dispute_reason (string) - Ask user to select one. Must be exactly one of these values:
   - 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge': Charge was not authorized or is fraudulent
   - 'duplicate_charge': Same charge appeared multiple times
   - 'incorrect_amount': Amount charged differs from expected
   - 'goods_services_not_received': Never received what was paid for
   - 'goods_services_not_as_described': Received item/service differs from description
   - 'canceled_subscription_still_charging': Subscription was cancelled but charges continue

    - 'full_refund': Complete refund of the transaction amount

    - 'reversal_of_charge': Charge reversal/chargeback
